name: MathlibAnnex.CStarAlgebra.compactPreimageIdeal
title: The preimage ideal of the compact operators

content.display_title: The preimage ideal of the compact operators
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be a complex $C^*$-algebra, with no unit assumed, let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space, and let $\rho:A\to\mathcal B(H)$ be a $*$-representation. Define $$J_\rho=\rho^{-1}(\mathcal K(H))=\{a\in A:\rho(a)\text{ is compact}\}.$$ The declaration packages this set as a two-sided ideal of $A$.
content.definition_explanation: The ideal laws follow from $$\rho(0)=0,\quad \rho(a+b)=\rho(a)+\rho(b),\quad \rho(-a)=-\rho(a),\quad \rho(ab)=\rho(a)\rho(b),$$ together with the facts that compact operators are closed under sums, negatives, and composition on either side by a bounded operator.
content.assumptions: No unit, separability, irreducibility or faithfulness assumption is used.
content.conclusion: The result is the algebraic two-sided ideal $J_\rho$. The definition does not assert norm closedness here.
lean_realization_notes: The later theorem [Norm closedness of the compact-preimage ideal](https://github.com/r-tanaka-math/mathlib-annex/blob/437e6e46228bbb8e91211ebded349d7a30020e73/MathlibAnnex/Analysis/CStarAlgebra/CompactPreimage.lean#L72-L92) proves norm closedness: $\rho$ is contractive and hence continuous, and $I_\rho=\rho^{-1}(\mathcal K(H))$ is the inverse image of the norm-closed set of compact operators. This observation is kept separate from the algebraic construction.
